method.approach: Chapter-level sim mapping (hand-curated from every sim's teaching text, doc comment and title, matched against each chapter's node definitions in enhanced_nodes_index.json and the NCERT chapter titles in catalog_class12_*.json), then per-node diagnostic coverage scoring of each node's 6 diagnostics (q+a+misconception) against the full text of the mapped sim component(s) across simulations/c6_12, /c6_12_new and /three.
method.heuristic: A diagnostic counts covered when 0.65 * (IDF-weighted share of its question-stem terms present in the sim source text) + 0.35 * (share of its answer terms) >= 0.40. Both the diagnostic and the sim text are stemmed with the same light stemmer and matched by equality or shared prefix, plus a curated synonym table (e.g. percent->'%', colligative->'osmotic pressure'). IDF is computed over the ~330 class-12 chapter documents so common academic vocabulary cannot fake coverage. GOLD = all diagnostics covered; PARTIAL = at least two diagnostics covered; MISSING = no mapped sim or fewer than two diagnostics covered. Lexical heuristic - conservative on metaphorical sims; boundary cases were hand-verified (see spot_checks).

limitations: Lexical term-presence scoring, not interaction testing: a sim may exercise a skill without naming it, or name it without a scored interaction.

Sims scoped to dropped NCERT chapters (solid state, surface chemistry, metallurgy, chemistry in everyday life, ecosystem/biodiversity/environmental issues) or to subjects absent from the node index (EVS, Legal Studies, Mass Media, the Java CS track) deliver nothing to the current class-12 nodes and are listed explicitly.
English and Hindi literature subjects have no simulations at all; every one of those nodes is structurally MISSING.
Answer-key defect scan is structural (index range, duplicate options, numeric key type, % of arithmetic); it does not re-derive every computed answer.

spot_checks.description: 15 verdicts hand-verified across subjects against the actual sim interactions (stratified sample; fixed list recorded in the audit script).

checks.note: EnergyLevelsHydrogen sim carries 18 references to 13.6 eV plus energy-level/ground-state/ionisation labs - all six H-atom energy diagnostics exercised.
3D LinesPlanesSpace lab classifies skew/parallel/intersecting and computes the shortest gap live (d=|w|/|n|); the open design task and the negative-distance misconception killer remain uncovered.
ElectrochemistryCBSE sim has molar-conductivity, cell-constant, KCl and strong/weak-electrolyte content matching all six Lambda_m diagnostics.
Jaipur partnership sim has deed-silent Section-13 default challenges, interest on capital/drawings and salary-vs-interest P&L appropriation mapping.
NationalIncomeCBSE + CircularFlowIncome sims carry 95 combined deflator/CPI/real-GDP references.
MolecularBasisCBSE sim has Meselson-Stahl/semi-conservative replication content; LinkageCrossingOver adds lab evidence.
PsychologicalDisordersCBSE sim covers GABA/schizophrenia neurotransmitter quizzes and behavioural/cognitive model contrasts.
CulturalChange sim contains a single incidental 'Westernisation' token; no Srinivas definition, two-forms distinction or sanskritisation-contrast content.

Undercall: the GraphicalRepresentation sim has an interactive bar/line/pie switcher with a y-axis truncation toggle ('starts at 10, not 0') that directly exercises the line-graph purpose and the Y-axis-zero-critique diagnostics under different vocabulary.
Networks sims have zero twisted-pair/coaxial/fibre/transmission-media content - guided media is a genuine topical gap.
ClinicalNutrition sim exercises diet-planning and vitamin-D-adjacent skills; the fat-soluble-vitamin mechanics diagnostics (micelles, Bitot's spots) are uncovered.
Overcall: the PandasSeries1 sim contains zero occurrences of read_csv/read_excel (the lexical hits were HTML header tags); the CSV/Excel import-mechanics diagnostics are never exercised.
RiceGenomeProject sim carries HGP/shotgun/base-pair content; GenomeTechnology and Sanger sims add sequencing-strategy evidence.

ThinkersBeliefsBuildings sim is exclusively Sanchi stupa architecture (anda, harmika, toranas) with one 'Buddha' mention; the Buddha-biography diagnostics (Lumbini, Four Sights, aniconic art) are unexercised.

Overcall: the WorkingCapitalTurnover sim is a working-capital velocity / profitability-ratio / ROCE spreadsheet lab with one incidental 'cash flow' phrase; the direct-method cash-flow-statement skill is never taught.
